newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt bourse-IBIS orientation phase starts.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt bourse-IBIS orientation phase starts.

text.p: The Frankfurt bourse said that an IBIS price orientation phase has started and will last until 1145 GMT when normal trading will start.
The bourse has been suffering from technical difficulties much of the morning and trade had been interrupted earlier.
The exchange did not say what specific difficulites it faced.
Earlier in the day, the IBIS DAX index set a new record high, climbing to 2,955.76.
